<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Thaw the project: work resumes.

```text
Undoes the 'anchors freeze': removes the freeze from anchors.yaml, deletes the
ruleset and closes the issue.

The commit and the push go out with --no-verify for the same reason as the freeze: while the
remote still says 'frozen', the hooks would refuse the thaw itself.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors thaw [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-push` |  | do not commit or push anchors.yaml |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Freezing the project — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors freeze`](/docs/cli/commands/freeze/) | Freeze the project: nobody works until `anchors thaw` |
| **`anchors thaw`** | Thaw the project: work resumes |

<!-- cli-reference:end -->
